summary: Tested all 4 UI/UX fixes in the RPG game 'A Returned Spirit'. All fixes verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used AsyncStorage (localStorage) injection to simulate morning state and Tuesday bag-unlock state for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 fixes verified: Fix1=bag icon 96x96 cover, Fix2=Rupert bubble full-width centered, Fix3=correct text, Fix4=fade-to-black+walking sound on downstairs

fix1_bag_icon_cover.detail: BagIconButton renders bag1.png at 96x96px with resizeMode=cover, filling the golden circle completely. Visually confirmed via screenshot on Tuesday state.

fix2_rupert_bubble_centered.detail: Rupert 'Wait, take this.' bubble uses bubbleLeftCalc=16, bubbleRightCalc=16 (fixed values), making it span full device width minus 16px margins. Arrow points toward Rupert (center portrait). Visually confirmed in screenshot.

fix3_dormitory_text.detail: Clicking 'Go to sleep.' in morning mode shows "It's too early to sleep again." (not the old 'not tired enough' text). Verified programmatically and via screenshot.

fix4_go_downstairs_fade.detail: Clicking 'Go downstairs.' triggers fade-to-black animation (700ms) + walking-on-wood sound. Full black screen captured in screenshot during animation. router.back() called after fade completes. Note: GO_BACK warning in test is expected since we navigated directly to /dormitory without stack.
